objects.definition:
struct TextureKernelParams
{
    const float*    tex[TEX_MAX_MIP_LEVEL];         // Incoming texture buffer with mip levels.
    const float*    uv;                             // Incoming texcoord buffer.
    const float*    uvDA;                           // Incoming uv pixel diffs or NULL.
    const float*    mipLevelBias;                   // Incoming mip level bias or NULL.
    const float*    dy;                             // Incoming output gradient.
    float*          out;                            // Outgoing texture data.
    float*          gradTex[TEX_MAX_MIP_LEVEL];     // Outgoing texture gradients with mip levels.
    float*          gradUV;                         // Outgoing texcoord gradient.
    float*          gradUVDA;                       // Outgoing texcoord pixel differential gradient.
    float*          gradMipLevelBias;               // Outgoing mip level bias gradient.
    int             enableMip;                      // If true, we have uv_da and/or mip_level_bias input(s), and a mip tensor.
    int             filterMode;                     // One of the TEX_MODE_ constants.
    int             boundaryMode;                   // One of the TEX_BOUNDARY_MODE_ contants.
    int             texConst;                       // If true, texture is known to be constant.
    int             mipLevelLimit;                  // Mip level limit coming from the op.
    int             channels;                       // Number of texture channels.
    int             imgWidth;                       // Image width.
    int             imgHeight;                      // Image height.
    int             texWidth;                       // Texture width.
    int             texHeight;                      // Texture height.
    int             texDepth;                       // Texture depth.
    int             n;                              // Minibatch size.
    int             mipLevelMax;                    // Maximum mip level index. Zero if mips disabled.
    int             mipLevelOut;                    // Mip level being calculated in builder kernel.
};
objects.description: Kernel parameter bundle for nvdiffrast texture sampling/building CUDA kernels. Holds pointers to input/output tensors (base and mip levels), gradients, and configuration such as filtering mode, boundary handling, dimensions, channel count, and mip settings. Used as a POD struct passed to CUDA kernels; no constructors/destructors defined here.

functions.name: raiseMipSizeError
functions.description: Reports an error related to invalid or inconsistent mipmap sizing for a texture sampling operation. Intended to be called when the TextureKernelParams describe a texture/mip configuration that violates expected size relationships. Likely throws via the framework’s error macros (e.g., NVDR_CHECK) and does not return on failure. Usage: invoke after validating texture dimensions and computed mip sizes to surface a clear diagnostic.
requirements: p must reference a valid, initialized TextureKernelParams structure.
The fields in p relevant to texture/mipmap sizing (e.g., texWidth, texHeight, mipLevelMax, enableMip, tex[] pointers) should be set to reflect the problematic state being reported.
Caller should not expect a return value; this function is intended to raise/throw on error.

functions.name: calculateMipInfo
functions.description: Computes mipmap-related information for texture sampling based on the given TextureKernelParams and writes per-level offsets into mipOffsets. Modifies p to record derived mip settings (e.g., maximum mip level or output level). Returns an integer result (exact meaning unknown from this header; commonly the number of mip levels or the total texel count across levels). Usage: call after populating p with base texture properties to prepare texture sampling/kernels that use mipmaps.
requirements: p must reference a valid, initialized TextureKernelParams structure with dimensions (texWidth, texHeight, texDepth) and other fields set consistently for the texture to be used.
mipOffsets must be a non-null pointer to writable memory large enough to store offsets for all mip levels that may be computed (up to TEX_MAX_MIP_LEVEL entries).

Caller must handle the returned int; the precise interpretation (e.g., number of levels vs. total size) is unknown from this header and should be verified against the implementation or higher-level documentation.
Because p is non-const, the caller must be prepared for p’s mip-related fields (e.g., mipLevelMax, mipLevelOut) to be modified.

endpoints.name: calculateMipInfo
TextureKernelParams *

unharnessable_functions.name: raiseMipSizeError
unharnessable_functions.reason: This function is intended to unconditionally raise/abort on error, which would terminate the fuzzing process and cannot be safely exercised in a harness.
